Plastic surgeon in private practice at the Assuta clinic and head of the Institute of Plastic Surgery in Tel Aviv.

Specialisations:

  • Plastic surgery
  • Reconstructive surgery
  • Aesthetic surgery

Education:

  • 1991 — graduated with distinction from the faculty of medicine, Tel Aviv University.
  • Fellowships in plastic surgery at the Beilinson and Kaplan clinics and at a Harvard University hospital in the United States.
  • Fellowship in microsurgery, hand surgery and aesthetic surgery at the University of Melbourne, Australia.

Clinical and academic experience:

  • Worked as a plastic surgeon in Cape Town, South Africa, carried out research at Harvard University, and is currently a lecturer at Monash University in Australia.
  • Head of the plastic surgery outpatient clinic at the Ichilov clinic.
  • Teaches students in Israel and other countries.
  • Active participant in scientific conferences and the author of numerous publications in research journals and of chapters in academic works.

Professional associations:

  • Israel Society of Plastic Surgeons
  • International Society of Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
  • Australian Hand Surgery Society

Dr Ran Harel: an outstanding neurosurgeon and specialist in spinal radiosurgery

Specialisation:
Dr Ran Harel is an outstanding neurosurgeon specialising in the removal of tumours of the spine and spinal cord and in spinal radiosurgery. He has mastered intra-operative navigation systems such as the O-arm and i-MRI and has successfully performed hundreds of spinal fusion operations and operations to remove various types of spinal tumour and correct spinal deformity.

Education:

  • Graduated from the faculty of medicine, Tel Aviv University, in 2002.
  • Completed a residency in neurosurgery at the Sheba medical centre in 2008.
  • Undertook advanced training and took part in research in spinal surgery at the Cleveland Clinic, USA, from August 2008 to July 2010.
  • Recently completed advanced courses in spinal radiosurgery and the treatment of spinal tumours by precisely targeted irradiation.

Membership of international associations:

  • Member of the Israel Neurosurgical Society.
  • Member of the Israel Spine Society.
  • Member of the international association of spinal surgeons, AO Spine.
  • Member of the International Society of Arthroscopy, Knee Surgery and Orthopaedic Sports Medicine (ISAKOS).

Dr Ran Harel is a senior physician in the spine and radiosurgery units of the neurosurgery department at the Chaim Sheba Medical Centre. He is known for his achievements in minimally invasive spinal surgery, cervical spine surgery, spinal tumour surgery and the radiosurgery of spinal tumours. His extensive experience and innovative approach to treating the spine and spinal cord have made him one of the leading specialists in his field.

Dr Ron Arbel, an outstanding orthopaedic surgeon, is known for his achievements in the treatment of osteoarthritis, arthritis and sports injuries, and in arthroscopy and joint replacement. He successfully treats the knee, elbow and shoulder joints, heads a sports medicine centre and chairs the Israel Society of Sports Medicine. Dr Arbel is also chief physician to Israel's national volleyball team and a consultant to basketball and football clubs.

Education

  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel.
  • Internship in orthopaedics and trauma at the University of Siena, Italy.
  • Specialisation in orthopaedic surgery at the Assaf Harofeh Medical Centre, Israel.
  • Residency at the Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv, Israel.
  • Fellowships in sports medicine and joint arthroscopy at clinics in Austria, Belgium, Germany and Ireland.
  • Fellowship in arthroscopy of the shoulder, knee, ankle and hip in the United States (Boston, Los Angeles, Chicago, Nashville).

Languages

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations

  • President of the Israel Society of Sports Medicine (ISSM).
  • Member of the Israel Orthopaedic Association (IOA).
  • European Federation of Sports Medicine Associations (EFSMA).
  • American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons (AAOS).
  • North American association of arthroscopic surgeons (AAN).
  • International Society of Arthroscopy, Knee Surgery and Orthopaedic Sports Medicine (ISAKOS).

Dr Ron Grinberg has rich surgical experience spanning more than 23 years. His professional path began with thorough training at well-known medical institutions in Israel and was later complemented by fellowships at first-rate clinics in Italy and Austria.

His main specialisation is laparoscopic surgery, in which he is considered a true expert. In his practice Dr Grinberg uses innovative methods and instruments aimed at preserving the organ and easing the patient's recovery. Among his advanced techniques are the use of Doppler and stapling in operations on the anus, and the use of the newest energy devices.

Dr Grinberg removes dangerous bowel tumours, treats haemorrhoids and fissures, and introduces techniques for correcting fistulas using biological glue and for reconstructing the pelvic floor. Among his other notable procedures are laparoscopic partial removal of the gall bladder, operations to repair various hernias, and sigmoidectomy. Thanks to his experience and professionalism, many thousands of operations have ended in success.

Dr Grinberg also shares his experience actively in the research community. His portfolio includes more than 30 research publications, and he teaches at Tel Aviv University. He also takes part regularly in leading international medical conferences.

EDUCATION

  • Faculty of Medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel
  • Faculty of Medicine, Ben-Gurion University, Beersheba, Israel
  • Fellowship in the fundamentals of reconstructive surgery of the pelvic floor and anus, Austria
  • Specialisation in the treatment of haemorrhoids using Doppler technology at the Medical University of Graz, Austria
  • Specialisation in laparoscopic operations on the colon, Italy
  • Research in clinical immunology at the Weizmann Institute, Rehovot, Israel

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Association of General Surgery
  • Israel Society of Colorectal Surgery
  • European Society of Coloproctology
  • American Society of Colon and Rectal Surgeons

Gynaecologist

Professor Ron Hauser is a distinguished expert in reproductive medicine. Over time he has become a byword for professionalism and excellence in obstetrics, gynaecology and the treatment of infertility.

His extensive experience and deep knowledge allow Professor Hauser to diagnose and treat a wide range of gynaecological conditions successfully. He studies new techniques and methods continually, so that his patients can always count on the most advanced treatment available.

A particular place in his practice belongs to IVF (in vitro fertilisation), which has become a source of hope for many couples facing infertility. Besides IVF, Professor Hauser applies the Micro-TESE technique with great skill — a specialised microsurgical method used in the diagnosis and treatment of male infertility.

Professor Ron Hauser is not merely a practising doctor; he also takes an active part in research and publishes regularly in international medical journals. He is, in addition, a member of several professional organisations and associations concerned with reproduction.

One of the key areas of his professional work is heading the sperm bank at one of Israel's leading clinics. Under his direction the sperm bank has taken a leading position in the cryopreservation and storage of reproductive material, providing comprehensive services for those facing infertility.

His guiding principle is an individual approach to every patient. Thanks to his deep knowledge, his experience and his sincere wish to help, many families have found the happiness of parenthood.

Education:

  • Hebrew University of Jerusalem (faculty of medicine).
  • HaKirya medical centre, Tel Aviv (specialisation in the treatment of gynaecological conditions).
  • Monash University in Melbourne, Australia (specialisation in andrological microsurgery and participation in research).

Membership of medical associations:

  • National society
  • European society
  • American society for reproductive medicine
  • National association of obstetricians and gynaecologists

Dr Ronen Alkalay is an authority in dermato-oncology with 30 years of continuous experience in treatment. His specialisation covers the diagnosis and treatment of all forms of skin tumour, including melanoma and basal cell carcinoma. He trained in the United States, where he studied advanced techniques such as the Mohs method, considered one of the most effective in the fight against skin cancer.

Over decades of practice Dr Alkalay has helped thousands of patients defeat skin tumours, leaving no trace behind. He is also an expert in treating a wide variety of dermatological and venereal conditions.

One of Dr Alkalay's striking achievements is his high rate of successful outcomes in treating malignant growths — up to 99 per cent. In each individual case he draws up a personal treatment plan using a comprehensive multidisciplinary approach, which secures the best results for the patient.

Since 2014 Dr Alkalay has held his place steadily on the list of the best dermatologists compiled by Forbes, which confirms his high professional standing and the trust of his patients.

EDUCATION

  • School of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Specialisation in the dermatology department of the Hadassah university hospital in Jerusalem, Israel
  • Fellowship in micrographic surgery with the American College of Mohs Surgery, USA

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Society of Dermatology and Venereology
  • American Academy of Dermatology
